{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_dup_count = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {patient_dup_count}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
baseline_neg999 = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {baseline_neg999}')

# Check assay_batch values
print(f'Unique assay_batch values: {df["assay_batch"].unique()}')

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient_id
df_grouped = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Max sample_seq per patient: {df_grouped.describe()}')"}
